t: The Fortress Trade 2" Long Reach Angled Paint Brush is designed for precise cutting in and reaching confined areas. This professional decorating brush features solid round tapered synthetic filaments that provide superb paint load capacity and excellent control across all paint types. Its mixed filaments significantly reduce tramlines, ensuring a smooth finish. The brush incorporates a long, ergonomic wooden handle, making it ideal for accessing difficult spaces in both domestic and commercial painting projects, and it is quick and easy to clean after use.
